d:
Can an IAS officer really dream of becoming the Chief Minister of Maharashtra? A recent question put to IAS officer Tukaram Mundhe sparked curiosity about his political ambitions. Known for his straightforward attitude, strict administrative style and no-nonsense approach, Mundhe has often made headlines for his work and controversial transfers. But what exactly did he say when asked whether he wanted to become Maharashtra's Chief Minister? Did he express any interest in entering politics, or did he give a completely different response?
